sha_binding.verified_source_note: Implementation commit on this branch: carried predecessor blobs, the precondition marker, the refusal drill script, and its workflow job registration. Commits after this must be proof-path only, which proof-binding-validator enforces mechanically. Post-merge closeout rebinds to the authoritative merge SHA.

known_limitations: The refusal drill cannot run on the authoring workstation: no local Postgres and the Docker daemon is unreachable. Per standing PM direction not to block on local Docker or workstation software changes, it runs in hosted CI.

The drill runs against an ephemeral scratch database, so it proves the guard's behaviour, not that production's current state matches expectations. Production state remains covered by Live Schema Parity.
